text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOOOOOOOAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Haaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The crucial moment, a ferocious battle!!
She's moving up! Here comes Tanino Gimlet!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(—I can tell!
Kris S and I are smashing through
each other's limits...!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(What a sweet sound!
Yes, we can――
elevate each other to endless heights!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —And yet!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—This victory right here, right now, at least!!!!!
Is mine, Kris S!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
With the run of this "God of Destruction"!!!!
"Destiny"!! Shatter into pieeeeces!!!!
(SKREEEEEECH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――Here comes Tanino Gimlet charging in!!
Surging ahead further and further!!
Tanino Gimlet takes the leaaaaad!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Tanino Gimlet reaches the goal!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heheh... chuckle...
Hahahaha...――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahahaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
…………I...
I will never forget this race
for the rest of my life...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...That... applies to me as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Watching you run... made me... understand.
...That I too... have no limits.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So this is――――the God of destruction.
...—Tanino Gimlet, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed……!!
And welcome……! To the new world!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S—
You have now... been reborn.
—How do you feel?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "...I will become stronger once more. So—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Let's run "Again."
"As many times as it takes"... "Again"――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
——"Time and time again," "once more."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how many times
this world repeats itself—)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: (We are destined to cross paths and compete.)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: (Relying on the sound of the chains of our mutual destinies ringing, and the weight they impart—)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: (We are————fated to be this way.)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Lady Gimlet!! Gimleeeet!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, scream!! Call forth my name!!
Behold my advent, Tanino Gimlet—the God of Destruction!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Today, you all bore witness to myth!!
The time for revolution has come!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Gaze upon it!! Praise it!! Drink it in!!
Surrender your very souls to the frenzy!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
――Trainer.
Allow me to declare the next place where I shall descend.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: By now, there's no need to even confirm it with you, is there?

Now that she's defeated Symboli Kris S,
the stage for the "God of Destruction" to wield her power next
is naturally limited...!

Next—
It is time to unleash the "God of Destruction" upon the world!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
――I declare it.
The next stage of destruction, it is――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup!!
To all across this world!!
I shall reveal the radiance of the God of Destruction who governs the fleeting moment!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Ooooooohhhh!?)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Witness the coming of the end!!
Every single one of you
shall become the tellers of myth!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
I shall tear everything down to the ground...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...Gimlet's way of talking is kinda unique, so I often don't really get it, but it feels like Trainer somehow understands it all.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise we couldn't pull off something this incredible,
and we wouldn't be standing in the line of fire for each other, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, you're right!

Toward the next realm of descent, the Japan Cup—
the "God of Destruction" charges forward without pause.
